Intel: Java package declaration emitted as Module so callers can build FQNs (#112)

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { process } from "@xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = process("package com.example.widget;\n\npublic class Widget {\n    public String name() { return \"w\"; }\n}\n", { language: "java" });
  console.log(result.language);
  console.log(result.structure);
  console.log(result.structure[0].kind);
  console.log(result.metrics.errorCount);
}

void main();
```
